title: kubernetes: TXT lookups for cluster names now return NXDOMAIN
quote: plugin/kubernetes: error NXDOMAIN for TXT lookups
remediation: Clients that probe cluster names with TXT queries (some service-discovery libraries do) now get NXDOMAIN instead of NODATA; libraries that treat NXDOMAIN as "name does not exist" may stop resolving the A record afterwards.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get cm -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("coredns")) | .metadata.name as $n | (.data // {})[] | split("\n")[] | select(test("^\\s*kubernetes\\b")) | $n + ": " + .'  # the printed kubernetes block answers TXT for cluster names with NXDOMAIN from 1.10.1
